neutral.meaning: Portable services and standard interfaces owned by the shared layer.
The compatibility ABI itself: nxp.ui, nxp.settings, nxp.files and nxp.frame.

hosts.meaning: Host-only interfaces and game integrations owned by EmblemWeave.
Host-only interfaces and game integrations owned by fefw-recomp.
Host-only interfaces and game integrations owned by ObeliskChamber.

rules: A prefix is a lowercase dotted namespace: [a-z0-9-]+ followed by a dot.
A host answers for its own prefix and for no other host's prefix.
trinity. is always portable. nxp. is always the compatibility ABI.
A host interface name must carry exactly one owner prefix. The loader rejects unknown and doubled prefixes.
Short aliases are accepted for input and diagnostics but canonical names are written to disk.
Reserved first segments are systemic and cannot be claimed by a plugin.
The full name, not the short name, is the identity. Two hosts may both expose ui.settings without colliding.
Existing NxModApi entry points remain valid. Prefixes are added at the interface registry, not forced onto old symbols.
